defects.what: The spike's plan is implemented but the spike was not moved to design/spike/archived/ and the tracker still links the old path, against the spike README's lifecycle step 5.
DumpFeedResult hand-writes the action's {data}|{error} shape instead of deriving it from fetchDumpEntriesAction's return type, so it drifts silently if the action changes.
The two route adapters differ in form (const arrow vs function declaration).
Dump's scenario adapter wrapper lives in page.tsx while Priorities' prioritiesPage helper lives in fixtures.ts.
openAddTask is a const arrow while its sibling writes trackTask and completeTask are function declarations.
DumpPageData keeps initial*-prefixed prop names while the other pages' <Feature>PageData types name their rows plainly.
